# During vector-search development, the lambda layer installs Prismarine from a
# locally built wheel of the vector-indices branch (SAM's pip layer builder can't
# resolve a git VCS URL). The wheel carries runtime.dynamo_vectors + the [vectors]
# extra and the vector-search fixes. Rebuild it after branch updates with:
#   uv run python -m pip wheel "prismarine[vectors] @ git+https://github.com/scartill/prismarine.git@vector-indices" --no-deps -w thirdparty/wheels
# Switch back to `prismarine[vectors]>=<released>` once the feature ships to PyPI.
